dialogues.speaker: Hajanad
dialogues.text: Hehe... Haha... Hooheehahahe... Cheer up, my little animals, I've cooked you a delicious treat...

choices.text: Could you try sounding a little less... creepy?

response.speaker: Hajanad
response.text: Oh! I'm sorry, looking after these animals is so therapeutic! It's put me in a wonderful mood... Maybe I got a bit carried away with my laughter.

response.speaker: Hajanad
response.text: I'm a good person, though! I signed a contract and everything. There's no way I would hurt these little cuties!

response.speaker: Hajanad
response.text: Not to mention, as a new researcher, even if I did flee Fontaine, there's no way I could run away from Spantamad. Please believe me!

response.speaker: Hajanad
response.text: *sigh* It's this stupid laugh of mine. If only I could change it...

response.speaker: Hajanad
response.text: Of course! It wasn't easy for me to become a researcher, so I decided to take a little holiday to celebrate. Then I ran into this celebration in Fontaine, and so here I am, having fun while making a little extra money on the side...

response.speaker: Hajanad
response.text: I should say, the fact I was able to write a conclusive thesis and officially become a researcher was all due to you.

response.speaker: Hajanad
response.text: If you want, I can agree to only take half my salary as a way to show my gratitude.

choices.text: Be careful what you feed these animals...

response.speaker: Hajanad
response.text: I will! I've committed the safest, most nutritional feed formula to memory. This is a lot simpler than brewing potions, there's no way I can go wrong!
